hero.title: Sategaon
hero.tagline: A Beautiful Blend of Tradition and Modernity
hero.description: A progressive village blessed with natural beauty, Sategaon is known for its religious heritage, social unity and strong agricultural roots.

intro.title: A Village of Farmers and Hardworking People
intro.description: Sategaon is a progressive and naturally rich village in Anjangaon Surji taluka. Known for its religious heritage and social unity, the village is recognised as a place of farmers and hardworking people. Its fertile black soil and water resources keep the surrounding landscape lush and green.
intro.highlight: A prosperous village, enriched by nature and community spirit
intro.caption: Sujalam Sufalam Sategaon

highlights.title: The Spirit of Sategaon
highlights.description: The village's religious heritage, agricultural prosperity and active community life are important parts of its identity.

religiousHeritage.title: Religious Heritage
religiousHeritage.description: The Hanuman Temple and local places of worship are centres of faith for the villagers. The annual fair and public celebrations reflect the social harmony and unity of the community.

agriculturalProsperity.title: Agricultural Prosperity
agriculturalProsperity.description: The village's orange orchards, cotton and banana production are well known throughout the surrounding region. Progressive farmer groups and irrigation facilities are contributing to the village's prosperity.

communityLife.title: Community Life
communityLife.description: The youth of Sategaon are always active in education, arts and sports. The village's well-equipped school and library help preserve its rich cultural heritage.

closing.title: Sujalam Sufalam Sategaon
closing.description: A village where tradition, agriculture, natural resources and community spirit come together.
